d: In a World Chess Championship, winning is obviously the goal. But sometimes, refusing to lose can be just as important. D Gukesh has entered his contest against Javokhir Sindarov with the odds stacked against him, yet the Indian world champion has managed to make his opponent work for every advantage. The opening games have offered a fascinating look at chess preparation, time management and the battle of nerves at the highest level. Rupha Ramani dives deep into Gukesh’s approach, Sindarov’s challenge and the mind games shaping this World Chess Championship showdown.
